lines.en: label beachseven1:
scene clearnightsky
I woke up this morning with a strange image in my head.
lines.zh: 今天早上醒来时，我脑子里有一幅奇怪的画面。

lines.en: It’s me — alone in a cabbage patch, but each cabbage is colored with a different hue to match every single set of eyes I know.
lines.zh: 那是我——独自待在一片卷心菜地里，可每一颗卷心菜都被染上了不同的色调，对应着我认识的每一双眼睛。

lines.en: There’s even one for mine — growing all by itself in a row ten meters detached from the rest, swarmed by flies and other insects as I’m the only one the farmers neglected to spray with deterrent.
lines.zh: 其中甚至有一颗是属于我的——孤零零地长在离其他菜十米远的一垄上，被苍蝇和其他虫子团团围住，因为我是唯一一个农民忘了喷洒驱虫剂的。

lines.en: Though, it seems more like they forgot me entirely given how beautiful the rest are.
lines.zh: 不过，看其他那些长得有多好，倒更像是他们彻底把我给忘了。

lines.en: Some are doing better than others. Like a blue one and a pink one. Which is impressive on its own as it seems their sunlight is blotted out by massive spheres of ruby and aquamarine that rule over the fields.
lines.zh: 有些长得比别的好。比如一颗蓝的和一颗粉的。单是这点就很了不起了，因为它们的阳光似乎被笼罩在田野上空、巨大的红宝石与海蓝宝石球体给遮住了。

lines.en: I know who these are for, of course — the two greatest loves I’ve ever had and the two who, if life was really fair, would grow even larger and feed me for all eternity.
lines.zh: 我当然知道这两颗是为谁长的——我此生最刻骨铭心的两段爱，也是如果这个世界真的公平的话，会长得更大、养我一辈子的两颗。

lines.en: This is not {i}my{/i} farm, though. I am merely a man who presently sees it. The cabbage growing in the corner, if you will.
lines.zh: 但这不是{i}我{/i}的农场。我只是一个恰好看见了它的人。可以说是长在角落里的那颗卷心菜。

lines.en: But if you {i}won’t,{/i} I implore you to dig deep within yourself for a scythe made of doubt to hack up the rest of what’s grown or is growing while you leave me here to fend off the flies.
lines.zh: 但如果你{i}不愿意{/i}，我恳请你在自己内心深处翻出一把由怀疑铸成的镰刀，把那些已经长成的、正在长的都砍个干净，而把我留在这儿赶苍蝇。

lines.en: I am certain this vision must have meant something, as does my request to have you falsify it before I can double it and give it to the next person.
lines.zh: 我确信这幅景象一定意味着什么，我也确信我请求你在我把它加倍、交给下一个人之前先把它证伪。

lines.en: And no, this is no plea to “save everyone else and leave me here to rot” or something of that nature. In fact, it’s quite the opposite as I would very much like to continue living. At least for right now.
lines.zh: 不，这不是什么「救其他人吧，把我留在这儿烂掉」之类的请求。事实上正好相反，因为我非常想继续活下去。至少现在是。

lines.en: My guess at what this image means, though, is that I grow in different ways. That, by “fending off the flies,” what I’m really doing is living inversely.
lines.zh: 不过我对这幅画面的猜测是：我以不同的方式生长。所谓「赶苍蝇」，我真正做的其实是逆向地活着。

lines.en: Picture this — that they are not here to feed on my decaying matter or give birth to their children, but to pick me clean like {i}I’ve{/i} become a termite queen myself.
lines.zh: 想象一下——它们来这儿不是为了啃食我腐烂的部分，也不是要在那儿产卵，而是要把我啃得干干净净，就好像{i}我{/i}自己成了白蚁蚁后。

lines.en: Then, once the rotten bits are gone, I’ll be born again. The farmers will return and look down at me as their last bit of hope. Then they’ll chop me up and mix me with pork and make me into gyoza.
lines.zh: 然后，等腐烂的部分都没了，我就会重生。农民们会回来，低头看着我，把我当成他们最后的一点希望。然后他们会把剁碎，和猪肉拌在一起，做成饺子。

lines.en: That’s the hope, at least. That’d give me purpose apart from making the other cabbages look more appetizing.
lines.zh: 至少希望是这样。那样我就有别的目的了，不再只是衬托别的卷心菜看起来更好吃。

lines.en: There’s probably something else, too. But you can check back at the end of the weekend once I’ve had some more time to think about it.
lines.zh: 大概还有别的意思。不过等这个周末结束、我多点时间想过之后，你再来问吧。

lines.en: In the meantime, I’m going to keep plowing the fields of this forgotten farm in hopes of uncovering something either buried beneath my feet or hidden somewhere inside of my head.
lines.zh: 在此期间，我会继续耕这片被遗忘的农场的地，希望能挖出点什么——不管是埋在我脚下的，还是藏在我脑子里某个地方的。

lines.en: It’d be really weird to just imagine an avant-garde cabbage patch for no reason after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟，无缘无故凭空想象出一片先锋派卷心菜地，那也太怪了。

lines.en: scene beachseven1
Especially while I’m surrounded by a bunch of teenage girls in an inn roughly twelve hours before any other adults arrive.
lines.zh: 尤其是在大约十二小时后才有其他大人到来、而我现在被一帮女高中生围在旅馆里的当口。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure it would make a lot more sense to just focus on them for now.
lines.zh: 我很确定，眼下把注意力放在她们身上要合理得多。

lines.en: : And so marks the start of yet another Rooftop Apocalypse Squad slumber party meeting! A ritual that, despite being almost entirely unsuccessful, is still fun no matter what!
lines.zh: : 那么，又一场天台末日小队睡衣派对例会就此开始！这个仪式虽说几乎从来没成功过，但不管怎样还是很好玩！

lines.en: scene beachseven2

: {size=-2}Now, if we could please get a moment of silence for Uta and Tsuneyo who were not able to join us today, it’d be both greatly appreciated and an excellent start to what I’m sure will be a very brief and very weird meeting.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}那么，请让我们为今天没能到场的 Uta 和 Tsuneyo 默哀片刻，感激不尽，而且这必定是这场又短又怪的例会的绝佳开场。{/size}

lines.en: scene beachseven3
: You make it sound as if they died.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像她们死了似的。

lines.en: : I’m confused. Tsuneyo is a part of this group as well? I was not aware of this.
lines.zh: : 我有点困惑。Tsuneyo 也是这个组织的一员吗？我此前并不知情。

lines.en: : Yeah, none of us really know what’s going on with her, to be honest. Sometimes she’s aware, sometimes she isn’t. So I just invite her to everything now to be safe.
lines.zh: : 是啊，说实话我们谁也不清楚她到底是什么状况。她有时清醒，有时不清醒。所以我干脆什么都叫上她，保险起见。

lines.en: : Seeing as a moment of silence is likely impossible in this group, I say we just move past your pseudo-eulogy and address the matter most dramatically at hand right now.
lines.zh: : 既然在这群人里默哀大概是不可能的，我建议跳过你那段伪悼词，直接处理眼下最富戏剧性的那件事。

lines.en: : You mean that your mom knows you’re gettin’ porked by the teacher and now thinks you’re crazy because she’s some kinda outlier?
lines.zh: : 你是说你妈知道你正被老师干着，而且因为她算是某种异常者，现在觉得你疯了？

lines.en: scene beachseven4
: Damn. That sucks.
lines.zh: : 靠。真惨。

lines.en: : It’s worse than when my dad died, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这比我爸死的时候还糟。

lines.en: : How {i}did{/i} your father die? I thought time was repeating itself.
lines.zh: : 你父亲{i}到底{/i}是怎么死的？我以为时间在不断重复。

lines.en: : Maybe he’s dying every single reset loop? And I’m allowed to say that without sounding like a bitch since that’s exactly what’s probably going on with {i}my{/i} mom from now on. Still kinda TBD on that.
lines.zh: : 也许他每一个重置循环都会死一次？这话由我说应该不算嘴贱，因为从今往后{i}我{/i}妈大概就是这么个情况。不过这个还有待观察。

lines.en: : Right, which is why we should spend the rest of the night planning out how to murder her so we can answer this question once and for all.
lines.zh: : 对，所以我们应该用今晚剩下的时间筹划怎么把她杀了，这样这个问题就能一次性彻底解决。

lines.en: scene beachseven5
: No, Makoto. We are not going to spend the night planning how to kill your mother. Parents are hard to come by in 1-A and we can’t just be getting rid of them whenever they inconvenience us.
lines.zh: : 不行，Makoto。我们不会花一晚上计划怎么杀你妈。在 1-A 班里父母是很稀罕的东西，我们不能一觉得他们碍事就把人处理掉。

lines.en: : Easy for you to say. Both of your parents are basically unaware of your existence while my only remaining one is {i}too{/i} aware.
lines.zh: : 你当然说得轻松。你爸妈基本都不知道有你这么个人，而我唯一剩下的那位倒是{i}太{/i}知道我的存在了。

lines.en: : This is what happens when it takes too long for shame to first reach a person. Makoto is ill-prepared to have other people know she’s having sex.
lines.zh: : 这就是羞耻感迟迟才降临到一个人身上会发生的事。Makoto 还没准备好让别人知道她在做爱。

lines.en: : There won’t be anything to be ashamed of anymore once I am a murderer.
lines.zh: : 等我成了杀人犯，就没什么可羞耻的了。

lines.en: : No murder. Bad Makoto. What we need to be doing right now is figuring out how to get your mom to join the apocalypse squad, not be excommunicated from the planet.
lines.zh: : 不许杀人。Makoto 乖。我们现在要做的是想办法让你妈加入末日小队，而不是把她从这颗星球上开除出去。

lines.en: scene beachseven6
: {i}Join?!{/i} Absolutely not! What can {i}she{/i} possibly contribute to any of this?!
lines.zh: : {i}加入？！{/i}绝对不行！{i}她{/i}到底能为这些事贡献什么？！

lines.en: : Yumi doesn’t really contribute either and we’ve never tried to kill her.
lines.zh: : Yumi 也没什么贡献，我们可从没试过杀她。

lines.en: : She did try to kill me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她确实试过杀我。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’d be trying it again right now if Ponytail weren’t in the fucking way.
lines.zh: : 对，要不是马尾挡在中间，我现在就再试一次。

lines.en: : Oh, good. Now I can’t get up for another drink without becoming an accomplice to murder. Slumber parties are so much fun.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。这下我连起身再去拿杯饮料都会变成杀人共犯。睡衣派对真是有意思。

lines.en: : Can we at least wait until after the next reset to...you know...{i}include{/i} her? Like, there’s a very real chance she gets sent back and we never have to deal with any of this again, right?
lines.zh: : 我们至少能等到下一次重置之后再……你知道的……把她{i}拉进来{/i}吧？毕竟她很可能被送回去，那我们就不必再面对这些了，对吧？

lines.en: scene beachseven7
: Do you know when this next “reset” is, exactly? Is there a specific date it usually occurs on? Any signs to look out for beforehand?
lines.zh: : 请问下一次「重置」确切是什么时候？它通常发生在某个特定日期吗？事前有什么征兆可循吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I feel like one needs to be coming up soon, though. Our last one spat us out in Christmalloween and that was like a whole nine months ago.
lines.zh: : 说不准。不过我感觉应该快了。上一次把我们从 Christmalloween 吐出来，那都像是整整九个月前的事了。

lines.en: : And “Christmalloween” is not actually a holiday in the {i}correct{/i} timeline, yes? It’s a product of time unraveling or something of that nature.
lines.zh: : 而「Christmalloween」在{i}正确{/i}的时间线里其实并不是一个节日，对吗？它是时间崩解的产物，或者类似的东西。

lines.en: : Right.
scene beachseven8
: No. Not right. Christmalloween is real and Ayane is lying to you. And you can definitely trust me because I’m the real Maya who was never reset or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 不对。不对。Christmalloween 是真的，Ayane 在骗你。而且你绝对可以信我，因为我才是真正的 Maya，从来没被重置过之类的。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Mhm, right. So you’ve just been acting like a brand new Maya ever since the first one disappeared and broke Sensei in half? And you are only revealing this now because of how important it is to preserve Christmalloween?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}嗯，对。所以自从第一个 Maya 消失、把 Sensei 劈成两半之后，你就一直在演一个全新的 Maya？而你现在才把这事说出来，是因为保住 Christmalloween 实在太重要了？{/size}

lines.en: scene beachseven9

: That’s right. Everything from the moment of my “disappearance” up until now was all a clever ploy to make Sensei fall in love with me again. And now that I have succeeded, there is no reason to keep it up.
lines.zh: : 没错。从我「消失」那一刻起到现在的一切，全都是一个巧妙的计谋，为了让 Sensei 重新爱上我。既然我已经成功了，就没必要再演下去了。

lines.en: scene beachseven10
: How come everybody in this fuckin’ class thinks that guy is in love with them?
lines.zh: : 怎么这个破班里人人都觉得那家伙爱上她们了？

lines.en: : You don’t need to say “that guy,” Yumi. I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 你不用说「那家伙」，Yumi。我就在这儿。

lines.en: scene beachseven11
: Cool, yeah. I’ll just ask you then. Why do all these morons think you’re in love with them when you’re really just a serial rapist?
lines.zh: : 行，那我就直接问你。为什么这帮白痴都觉得你爱她们，而你其实只是个连环强奸犯？

lines.en: : I imagine it’s a mix of boredom, lack of options, persistence, hope, competitive nature, my unrivaled manliness and remarkably good looks.
lines.zh: : 我想大概是无聊、别无选择、死缠烂打、心存希望、好胜心，再加上我无可匹敌的男子气概和出众的相貌，综合作用的结果。

lines.en: : That’s a lot of words to say they’re all just fuckin’ stupid.
lines.zh: : 说这么多字，意思就是她们都他妈蠢。

lines.en: scene beachseven12

: I agree, Yumi. It is quite obvious that Sensei is in love with me and me only and that everyone else has merely fallen victim to his charm, unrivaled manliness, and remarkably good looks. But I digress.
lines.zh: : 我同意，Yumi。很明显 Sensei 只爱着我一个人，其他人都不过是被他的魅力、无可匹敌的男子气概和出众的相貌给害了。不过我扯远了。

lines.en: : You can’t digress after a blatant lie like that! If anything, {i}Maya{/i} is the one he really loves here.
lines.zh: : 撒了这么明显的谎你还想扯远！要说的话，这里他真正爱的是{i}Maya{/i}才对。

lines.en: scene beachseven13
: See? Even Makoto knows.
lines.zh: : 看吧？连 Makoto 都知道。

lines.en: : Regardless of who loves who or why Christmalloween is fake or any other tangential thingy we’re almost getting sidetracked by, we came here for a reason and that reason is to make progress.
lines.zh: : 不管谁爱谁、Christmalloween 为什么是假的，也不管其他那些差点让我们跑题的旁枝末节，我们来这儿是有原因的，那个原因就是要取得进展。

lines.en: scene beachseven14

: Makoto, if your mom really is {i}aware{/i} now, we can’t just ignore her. Try thinking of it as an opportunity to have her support your relationship or something. I saw your PowerPoint. {i}I{/i} was convinced.
lines.zh: : Makoto，如果你妈现在真的{i}知道{/i}了，我们就不能装作没看见。你不妨把这当成一个机会，让她支持你的恋情什么的。我看过你的演示文稿。{i}我{/i}是被说服了的。

lines.en: : And the unfortunate truth is that if she experiences even a {i}fragment{/i} of what we have, who you’re sleeping with will be the {i}least{/i} of her worries.
lines.zh: : 而不幸的事实是，只要她体验到我们所经历的哪怕{i}一星半点{/i}，你跟谁上床就会变成她{i}最不重要{/i}的烦恼。

lines.en: : Somehow I doubt that...But still, I think we should at least wait until-
lines.zh: : 我总觉得不太可能……不过话说回来，我觉得我们至少应该等到——

lines.en: : Yes. We’ll wait until after the next reset to indoctrinate her. I doubt anything else would be able to convince her this is legitimate anyway.
lines.zh: : 好。我们等到下一次重置之后再给她洗脑。反正我也怀疑别的东西没法让她相信这一切是真的。

lines.en: : That it for the meeting then? We done?
lines.zh: : 那会就开到这儿了？完事了？

lines.en: : Not quite. There are still a few other matters we need to address. Sensei?
lines.zh: : 还没。还有几件事要处理。Sensei？

lines.en: : Ayane and I “woke up” with what seems like some sort of...shared memory or something after the last reset. But we don’t know how or why we wound up with it.
lines.zh: : 上一次重置之后，Ayane 和我「醒来」时带着某种……像是共享记忆之类的东西。但我们不知道它是怎么来的、为什么会落到我们头上。

lines.en: : The “memory” Sensei is referring to, if we’re going to call it that, is that Maya may or may not be the cause of this for some reason.
lines.zh: : Sensei 说的那段「记忆」——如果真能这么叫的话——是：Maya 可能是也可能不是这件事的起因，至于原因不明。

lines.en: scene beachseven15
: Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : {i}Bullshit{/i} is more like it. I think I’d know if I were God.
lines.zh: : 说{i}放屁{/i}还差不多。我要真是神，我自己会不知道？

lines.en: : Not exactly. And especially not if you’re a different person now from the one you were in the beginning.
lines.zh: : 未必。尤其如果你现在已经和最初的那个人不是同一个人了。

lines.en: : Don’t encourage them. This is annoying enough without a smart person on their team.
lines.zh: : 别给他们打气。这事儿已经够烦人了，他们那边再多个聪明人还得了。

lines.en: : Oh, well fuck me I guess. How exactly are we even supposed to investigate such a thing, though? Because it’s not as if we can trace Maya’s past when none of it is in the files.
lines.zh: : 哦，那好吧，操我呗。不过这种事我们到底要怎么查啊？Maya 的过去档案里一条都没有，我们总不能凭空追查吧。

lines.en: : That’s what the meeting’s for, Makoto! It’s not just Maya we need to “investigate,” though. It’s Ami too.
lines.zh: : 这就是开会的目的啊，Makoto！不过我们需要「调查」的不只是 Maya。还有 Ami。

lines.en: scene beachseven16
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: scene beachseven17
: She’s been acting {i}weird{/i} for a while now. {i}Very{/i} weird. And Maya will vouch for that. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 她这段时间一直很{i}不对劲{/i}。{i}非常{/i}不对劲。Maya 可以为这点作证。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Uh...y...yeah.
: Yeah, she’s...weird.
lines.zh: : 对，她……挺怪的。

lines.en: if otohaspring6 == True:
: Interesting. I wonder if this has anything to do with her going through all of my things the other day? Does she know I’ve gained knowledge of all this yet?
lines.zh: : 有意思。不知道这跟她前几天翻遍我的东西有没有关系？她知道我已经掌握了这些事的内情了吗？

lines.en: : She probably just smelled a lingering trace of Sensei on your belongings and wanted to check if he was inside of them.
lines.zh: : 她大概是闻到你东西上残留的 Sensei 的味道，想确认一下他是不是藏在里面。

lines.en: : Now, this {i}is{/i} Ami we're talking about. So she's always going to have {i}some{/i} bit of weirdness to her no matter what we do and I'm sure she has her reasons for that.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们说的{i}可是{/i} Ami。所以不管我们怎么做，她身上总会带{i}那么一点{/i}怪，而且我肯定她有自己的理由。

lines.en: : So I'm not suggesting we bombard her with {i}questions{/i} or invite her to these {i}meetings{/i} or anything of that nature- but that we simply be {i}wary{/i} of her. That's all.
lines.zh: : 所以我的意思不是要拿{i}问题{/i}轰炸她，也不是要请她来参加这些{i}会议{/i}之类的——只是要我们对她{i}留个心眼{/i}。就这些。

lines.en: : That was the method pre-reset Maya took, and I'm confident now that she did that for a reason. Even if pre-reset Maya was wrong like 75%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 重置前的 Maya 用的就是这个办法，我现在确信她那么做是有原因的。哪怕重置前的 Maya 有 75%% 的时候都是错的。

lines.en: : And I...still don’t think she’s involved.
lines.zh: : 而我……还是觉得她没牵涉其中。

lines.en: scene beachseven18

: Yes, and you can {i}keep{/i} thinking that since I don’t want you breaking down again in the event that she {i}is.{/i} You can leave her to us, Sensei. You just keep treating her the way you always do.
lines.zh: : 对，你{i}继续{/i}这么想也没关系，因为万一她{i}真的{/i}牵涉其中，我可不想看你再崩溃一次。她交给我们，Sensei。你只管像从前那样对她就好。

lines.en: : Or you can just man up and deal with the fact that sometimes, the people in your life ain’t what you thought they’d be.
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以像个男人一点，接受这个事实：有时候，你身边的人并不像你以为的那样。

lines.en: scene beachseven19
: Oh, thank you for picking {i}now{/i} to contribute, Yumi. What excellent timing for such helpful advice.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢谢你还挑了{i}现在{/i}这个点来发言，Yumi。这么有用的建议，时机选得真好。

lines.en: scene beachseven20

: I’m just sayin’, if the two of you guys {i}really{/i} want to put an end to all of this shit like you’ve been ranting about nonstop lately, the fuck is babying each other when shit gets hard gonna do?
lines.zh: : 我就说一句，要是你们俩{i}真的{/i}想像最近一直嚷嚷的那样把这破事彻底了结，那一旦日子难过就互相哄着，有个屁用？

lines.en: : Say that incestuous weirdo {i}does{/i} know something. Say she’s somehow the key to fuckin’ {i}all{/i} of this...
lines.zh: : 假设那个乱伦的怪胎{i}真的{/i}知道些什么。假设她莫名其妙就是解开这他妈{i}一切{/i}的钥匙……

lines.en: : Is Sensei just gonna hide in his room again while a bunch of stupid teenagers try to put the fucking world as we know it back together? Or is he gonna fucking {i}do{/i} something about it?
lines.zh: : 那 Sensei 是打算再躲回自己房间里，让一帮傻乎乎的高中生去把这个他妈的、我们所知的世界拼回去？还是他打算他妈的{i}做{/i}点什么？

lines.en: : Is there any {i}reason{/i} for this sudden hostility or are you just hungry again?
lines.zh: : 这突如其来的敌意{i}有{/i}什么理由吗，还是你又饿了？

lines.en: : Just thinkin’ out loud.
lines.zh: : 就是随口说说。

lines.en: : I don’t know shit about Ponytail or the fucking {i}genius{/i} over there, but Four Eyes and I don’t really mind stayin’ trapped here. So why should {i}we{/i} be doin’ all the work for the two people who {i}do{/i} want to leave?
lines.zh: : 马尾也好、那边那个他妈的{i}天才{/i}也好，我都不了解，可我跟四眼其实不介意被困在这儿。那凭什么要{i}我们{/i}替那两个{i}想{/i}走的人把所有活都干了？

lines.en: : I don’t wanna help somebody who ain’t gonna try to help themself. So you can keep all that Ami shit away from me. The less I need to talk to her, the better.
lines.zh: : 我可不想帮一个连自己都不肯救的人。所以那些 Ami 的破事别往我这儿堆。我跟她越少说话越好。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. That's kind of the point I was getting at.
lines.zh: : 我是说……对。我想说的其实就是这个。

lines.en: scene beachseven21
: I, too, find the idea of infinity quite appealing, if anyone would like my opinion.
lines.zh: : 如果有人想听我的看法的话，我也觉得「无限」这个概念相当有吸引力。

lines.en: : Fuck you, cunt. Get your {i}own{/i} fucking opinion. That one’s mine.
lines.zh: : 操你的，贱人。去搞你{i}自己{/i}他妈的看法去。这个是我的。

lines.en: : Why {i}do{/i} you want to leave, if I may ask? What is there to gain from a more {i}real{/i} version of reality?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，你为什么{i}想{/i}离开？从更{i}真实{/i}的现实里能得到什么？

lines.en: scene beachseven22
: Well, I...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，我……

lines.en: : You see, we...uh...
lines.zh: : 你看，我们……呃……

lines.en: : There’s something waiting for us outside of this place.
lines.zh: : 在这个地方之外，有什么东西在等着我们。

lines.en: scene beachseven23
: I don’t really know what it is and...I don’t think Ayane really knows either, but...
lines.zh: : 我也不太清楚那是什么，而且……我觉得 Ayane 其实也并不真的知道，但是……

lines.en: : Whatever it is, I don’t think we’re going to find here.
lines.zh: : 不管那是什么，我觉得我们在这儿是找不到的。

lines.en: : Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira……

lines.en: : Yumi is right about my attitude toward Ami. I need to stop being a coward and I shouldn’t rely on any of you to fight my battles for me.
lines.zh: : Yumi 说得对，我对 Ami 的态度有问题。我不能再当懦夫了，也不该指望你们任何人替我去打我的仗。

lines.en: : I’ll talk to her. I just...have to find the right time.
lines.zh: : 我会跟她谈的。我只是……得找个合适的时机。

lines.en: scene beachseven24
: Aight, well if Blondie’s just gonna stand there lookin’ all proud and {i}in love{/i} and shit, I’m gonna go take a walk and try not to throw up.
lines.zh: : 行吧，既然金毛就打算站在那儿一脸得意、一脸{i}坠入爱河{/i}的样子，那我出去走走，尽量别吐出来。

lines.en: scene beachseven25
: No, no. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 不，不。没关系。

lines.en: : We came to the beach a full day early to try and get each other up to speed, sure. But these meetings are more about just {i}being together{/i} than actually getting anything done.
lines.zh: : 我们提前整整一天来海边，确实是为了互相把情况同步一下。但这些会更多是为了{i}待在一起{/i}，而不是真要干成什么事。

lines.en: : As an FYI, Nodoka, she’s only saying that because we never get anything done.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，Nodoka，她这么说只是因为我们从来就没干成过任何事。

lines.en: : Thank you. I was unsure if the lackadaisical approach was the norm or if we were just abstaining from feasible progress on account of Uta’s absence.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我刚才拿不准这种懒散的作风是常态，还是因为 Uta 不在，我们才刻意不做任何可行的推进。

lines.en: : It’s the norm. This RSA shit is like 99%% planning and then waiting around for the world to do something before we can.
lines.zh: : 是常态。末日小队这破事大概 99%% 都是在计划，然后干等着世界先动起来，我们才动。

lines.en: : Again, this is more about just {i}being together{/i} than actually-
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这更多是为了{i}待在一起{/i}，而不是真的——

lines.en: scene beachseven26
: Yeah, I’m gonna go for a walk now. Nice {i}meeting,{/i} y’all.
lines.zh: : 行，我现在要出去走走了。{i}会{/i}开得真不错，各位。

lines.en: scene beachseven27
: Okay. Well, I guess I’ll just sit down too then.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我也坐下好了。

lines.en: scene beachseven28
: You think Sensei’s going to be okay talking to Ami?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Sensei 跟 Ami 谈得下来吗？

lines.en: : Only one way to find out. Seems more feasible than you talking to your mom at this point.
lines.zh: : 只有一种办法知道。眼下看来，这比让你去跟你妈谈要现实得多。

lines.en: : Well, yes. Ami doesn’t hold Sensei to the highest standard possible and my mother would rather me stay abstinent for thousands of years than sleep with someone her age.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。Ami 不会拿最高标准来要求 Sensei，而我妈宁可我禁欲几千年，也不愿我跟她那个年纪的人上床。

lines.en: : There is not nearly enough food here.
lines.zh: : 这儿吃的远远不够。

lines.en: scene beachseven29
: That’s your seventh pizza.
lines.zh: : 那是你的第七个披萨了。

lines.en: : I said what I said and I stand by it.
lines.zh: : 我说了我说的，我不改口。

lines.en: : {i}Yumi, may I speak to you for a moment?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Yumi，我能跟你说几句吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene beachseven30
: No. You may not.
lines.zh: : 不行。你不能。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Then, may I speak in your general direction and assume that you hear?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能否朝着你所在的大致方向说话，并假定你听得见？

lines.en: : The fuck do you want, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 你他妈想干嘛，Nodoka？

lines.en: : In hindsight, I believe stealing your clothes and commanding you to masturbate in the locker room may have been a mean thing to do.
lines.zh: : 事后想来，我觉得偷走你的衣服、还命令你在更衣室里自慰，也许是件挺过分的事。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 所以呢？

lines.en: : And I acknowledge that I was most likely in the wrong there.
lines.zh: : 而且我承认，那件事很可能是我做错了。

lines.en: : This an apology?
lines.zh: : 这是在道歉？

lines.en: : I’ll apologize to you when you apologize to Futaba for making her doubt herself more than she already does.
lines.zh: : 等你为让 Futaba 比原本更怀疑自己而向她道歉了，我就会向你道歉。

lines.en: : I {i}did{/i} apologize to her, you fucking-
lines.zh: : 我{i}道过{/i}歉了，你这个——

lines.en: : If merely saying the words “I’m sorry” was enough to make an apology sincere, I would have no trouble at all doing the same right now.
lines.zh: : 如果仅仅说出「对不起」这几个字就足以让道歉变得真诚，那我现在做同样的事也毫无困难。

lines.en: : But I have learned recently that it is not. And that these things must come from a place somewhere in close proximity to one’s chest cavity in order to come across as “real.”
lines.zh: : 但我最近才明白，并非如此。这些东西必须发自某个离胸腔很近的地方，才能显得「真实」。

lines.en: : You aren’t sorry for the things you said to Futaba. You still belittle her. You just do it behind her back now.
lines.zh: : 你对 Futaba 说的那些话，你并不觉得抱歉。你依然在贬低她。只不过现在改成背地里了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I never fucking commanded her to masturbate in a locker room.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我他妈从没命令她在更衣室里自慰。

lines.en: : Perhaps not. But you {i}have{/i} stolen her clothes. And had her parade herself around the showers looking for something to cover herself with like she has something to be ashamed of when she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 也许没有。但你{i}确实{/i}偷过她的衣服。还让她在淋浴间走来走去、到处找东西遮身子，好像她有什么该羞耻的，而她其实没有。

lines.en: : I’ve heard the stories. Of the things you’ve done to torment her despite her doing nothing to {i}you{/i} whatsoever. But I do not understand them as good antagonists typically come with a motive.
lines.zh: : 那些传闻我都听说了。你为了折磨她而做过的那些事——尽管她{i}对你{/i}什么都没做过。可我理解不了，因为像样的对手总该有个动机。

lines.en: : I have seen the way she cries and heard the shaking of her voice as the shame pours from out her mouth. But as I repeat these words to you, you stand there unchanged and unrepentant.
lines.zh: : 我见过她哭的样子，听过羞耻从她嘴里涌出来时声音的颤抖。可当我把这一切复述给你听时，你站在那儿，毫无动摇，也毫无悔意。

lines.en: : Is it that you take joy in hurting people? And merely picked the lowest hanging fruit you could? Or was there something else you were hoping to gain from breaking her?
lines.zh: : 是因为你以伤害别人为乐吗？只是挑了最唾手可得的那个？还是说，击垮她能让你得到别的什么？

lines.en: : Will you {i}ever{/i} be sorry?
lines.zh: : 你{i}到底会不会{/i}觉得抱歉？

lines.en: : Will {i}you,{/i} Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}呢，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Can machines even {i}feel{/i} in the first place?
lines.zh: : 机器到底能不能{i}感觉{/i}啊？

lines.en: : I am trying.
lines.zh: : 我在努力。

lines.en: : That’s why I am here.
lines.zh: : 这就是我在这儿的原因。

lines.en: : Well...maybe that’s why I’m here too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许这也是我在这儿的原因。

lines.en: : Okay. Well, goodbye then, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那……我想，就再见了。
